I built a Claude Code skill that surfaced the idea behind every video that grew my channel from zero to 10,000 subscribers, including three videos that each hit over 90k views. The skill is called /content-ideas. It runs in Claude Code (and Claude Chat, Cursor, and Codex), and today I'm giving it away free. In this video I show you the receipts, walk you through exactly how it works, and hand you the link to install it in under a minute.

The skill builds you a custom For You page across YouTube, Instagram, X, and TikTok, pulling only the highest performing posts from the creators you track scored by an outlier rating that shows how far each post beat that creator's own average. But the real edge is what it does underneath: it reads the comments on every post it analyzes, because that's where the angles the video itself didn't cover live. It also scrapes your own channel before every run, so it knows what you've already made and what your own audience is actively asking for. And because it uses Claude's auto-memory, every thumbs up and thumbs down you leave trains it to your taste — so the ideas it surfaces start to sound like you, not like an AI trend report.
